intro:
Each Center Stage musical plays 6 public performances to more than 2,200 audience members at the Mountain View Center for the Performing Arts. Every guest receives a printed program, and families often keep them as a souvenir of their young performer's show.

For 35 years, Peninsula Youth Theatre has given young people a place to grow on stage and behind the scenes. Your ad reaches local families while supporting youth arts education in our community.
